subject: Incident bot v2: MTTR targets + rollout risk (exec alignment by Wed)
body:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Incident bot v2: MTTR targets + rollout risk (exec alignment by Wed)

Marissa, Ava —

We need exec-level alignment on (a) MTTR targets we’ll commit to for Q1 reliability reporting and (b) rollout risk management for incident-bot v2 diagnostics. I’m aiming to close this out by EOD Wed (2/12) so SRE can plan the beta rotation and Platform/Telemetry can lock staffing.

Proposed MTTR targets (measured on Sev1+Sev2 incidents for Hosted + Dedicated; baselines pulled from SRE’s current sheet):
- Sev1: median MTTR down 30% (baseline ~52 min → target ~36 min)
- Sev2: median MTTR down 20% (baseline ~2h 05m → target ~1h 40m)
- “Time-to-triage” (first meaningful hypothesis) down 25% (measured via incident timeline markers / bot invocation)
- Context completeness score: 90% of incidents have all 3 cards present (deploy + config diff + saturation) within 2 minutes of /incident

Rollout risk / guardrails (what I want us aligned on):
1) Feature-flagged cohort rollout (SRE-only beta for 1 rotation; then expand)
2) Strict query budgets + caching + load shedding (bot must not worsen an incident)
3) Permissioning + audit logging for config diffs / privileged telemetry (no tenant unsafe data)
4) Clear backout criteria and a pre-approved rollback window

Resourcing asks (this is the part I need your explicit “yes/no” on):
- Telemetry: 1 engineer for ~2 weeks to land saturation query aggregation + caching guardrails and make sure dashboards are stable under incident load.
- Platform: 1 engineer for ~2–3 weeks for config diff endpoint hardening (authZ scopes + redaction tests + break-glass flow).
- Product/Console: support for deep links + measurement instrumentation (light lift, but needs ownership).

Deadlines (so we can actually ship):
- By Fri 2/14: security/compliance sign-off on permissioning + audit event schema.
- By Fri 2/28: beta in #incidents for SRE rotation (flag on; limited regions).
- By Fri 3/21: GA rollout (subject to beta metrics + no P0s).

Attached:
- mttr-baseline-and-targets_v0.4.xlsx (current baseline + target options)
- incident-bot-v2-rollout-risk-checklist_v0.2.docx

What I need from you both:
1) Confirm the MTTR targets you’re comfortable committing to publicly inside the org (reliability program dashboard).
2) Confirm owners + staffing for the Telemetry + Platform items above (or propose alternates).
3) Any “hard no” risk constraints I’m missing before I take this to staff.

Thanks,
Neha

—
Neha Kapoor
VP, Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference



From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 12:03 PM PST
Subject: Re: Incident bot v2: MTTR targets + rollout risk (exec alignment by Wed)

Aligned in principle on the targets + the phased rollout.

On targets:
- I’m comfortable committing to Sev1 median MTTR -30% and Sev2 -20% as written, as long as we’re clear these are for the incident classes we expect this to move (deploy regressions, misconfig, regional saturation) and we’ll segment in reporting.
- Context completeness at 90% is good, but I’d like the metric definition locked this week (what counts as “present” vs “present but empty due to permissions/timeouts”).

On reporting / KPI linkage:
- This maps cleanly to the reliability program KPI ticket (PM-312). We should also tie “adoption” (how often /incident or the bot cards are actually invoked) to avoid gaming completeness.

Resourcing:
- Product/Console: I can have Chloe own deep-link correctness + landing pages, and Paula can own the measurement spec and weekly readout cadence.
- Strong preference to keep GA gated on beta outcomes (2/28 → 3/21 feels OK if beta is clean).

One additional risk item: we should ensure the cards don’t become noisy/verbose. If we overwhelm the #incidents thread, we’ll lose the benefit. Suggest we keep the initial cards opinionated + short with “expand” actions.

If you want, I can put a 30 min exec readout on calendar Wed morning to make this explicit.

Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference



From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 3:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Incident bot v2: MTTR targets + rollout risk (exec alignment by Wed)

+1 to the overall plan. My “hard constraints” are on data handling + auditability.

For config diff + privileged telemetry access, I need the following explicitly called out as GA blockers:
1) Redaction must be allowlist-based (not just “best effort” secret pattern matching). Any field not in allowlist should render as “[REDACTED]”.
2) Break-glass flow must require an incident severity + justification string (even if it’s lightweight). We should also set a TTL for elevated access.
3) Audit events: record who/what invoked the diff, tenant scope (if any), and what endpoints were called. Retention should follow our standard for privileged access logs.
4) Slack rendering must not leak raw JSON blobs. Preview should be safe-by-default with explicit user action to expand.

Re: deadlines: Fri 2/14 is workable for sign-off if the latest permissioning + audit event schema is in front of me by Thu EOD.

Also flagging: if we’re measuring “context completeness,” I want the metric to treat “intentionally withheld due to missing permissions” differently than “failed due to timeout/error.” Those are different remediation paths.

Ava

—
Ava Chen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference



From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 8:22 AM PST
Subject: Re: Incident bot v2: MTTR targets + rollout risk (exec alignment by Wed)

Thanks both — capturing decisions + concrete asks so I can close this tomorrow.

Decisions (tentative unless you object by EOD today):
- MTTR targets: proceed with Sev1 median -30%, Sev2 median -20% for Q1 reliability reporting; segment by incident class in the weekly readout.
- Rollout: feature-flagged beta (SRE rotation) starting 2/28; GA target 3/21 contingent on beta outcomes and no P0 regressions.
- Metrics: “context completeness” will be defined with statuses per card: present_ok | present_redacted | withheld_permissions | failed_timeout | failed_error.

Exec asks / owners:
1) Product/Console
   - Owner: Chloe (deep links), Paula (measurement + weekly readout)
   - Deliverable by 2/21: deep-link parameter spec (service/region/time window) + where links should land in Console.

2) Security/Compliance
   - Owner: Ava (sign-off)
   - Deliverable by Thu 2/13 EOD: reviewed requirements doc for allowlist redaction + break-glass + audit event fields.
   - Target sign-off: Fri 2/14.

3) Resourcing confirmations (my open item)
   - I’m going to state in the staff update that we have:
     a) Telemetry: 1 eng for ~2 weeks (query aggregation + caching + guardrails)
     b) Platform: 1 eng for ~2–3 weeks (config diff hardening + scopes + break-glass wiring)
   If either of you thinks that’s unrealistic, tell me today so we adjust dates rather than slip silently.

I’ll also add Marissa’s note as a requirement: keep cards short + opinionated, with explicit “expand” affordances.

If you’re both okay with the above, I’ll send a short staff note tomorrow with targets + plan and attach the risk checklist.

Neha
